appraisal_events.evidence: surtout depuis qu'Odette avait présenté Forcheville aux Verdurin
appraisal_events.explanation: Odette brings Forcheville into the Verdurin circle, giving him an entry into the valued social space the passage otherwise shows Swann losing ground in; the text reports this as bare fact, mainly as the cause of Swann's distress, without further elaboration.

status_effects.explanation: His introduction to the Verdurin salon by Odette marks a modest, locally distinct inclusion, though the passage does not describe how he is received.

ambiguities: La princesse des Laumes (the character elsewhere canonicalized as duchesse de Guermantes) delivers a pointed quoted remark blaming Swann for rushing off from her dinner ('il se moque du monde'). This is a clear blame event, but its target is Swann, an already-scored character, so it cannot be recorded under supplement scope rules; the text offers no independent evaluation of her own standing (e.g., of her wit) that could be scored without relying on that forbidden target, so she is omitted despite her vivid presence in the scene.
